method.geometry: Five through sixteen changed frames. The before and after medians must be more similar than either is to the proposed middle. Use observed unambiguous faces with adjacent box IoU at least .25.
method.guard: Measure one central ellipse and four adjacent head sectors at each edge, subtract ordinary nearby motion. Reject a broad edge where at least two available sectors change by at least 6 grayscale levels and half the central residual. Require two visible sectors and central residual of at least 3 at both edges.
method.measure: At least .5 temporal IoU. Ordinary locations do not count as recovered synthetic edits.
method.point: Choose the stricter of 0.02 or the largest guarded candidate from ordinary selection files.
method.selection: Only the production coarse range routes a file. Score native boundaries within 12 frames of its endpoints.
method.transition: Compare three source-bound consecutive face embeddings on each side. Use cosine separation less within-side dispersion. Require positive raw change of at least .08 at each edge.
